integrity: All algebraic identities in the proof were independently replayed from the embedded verifier using exact symbolic arithmetic. Literature comparisons distinguish the exact six-coordinate diminished-Fermat map from different Fermat companion families.
scientific_limitations: The generic cusp normal form is proved away from the coordinate vertices and the finite chart-exception set where \(t^3=-1\). Those exceptional local types and any additional singularities of the image are not classified.
title: Generic cusp locus of the diminished-Fermat quintic companion map
